The goal is to transform an initial configuration of blocks into a desired goal configuration using a series of legal moves. Each move involves picking up a block and placing it either on another block or on the table. The constraints are that only one block can be moved at a time, a block can only be picked up if there is no block on top of it, and a block can only be placed on another block or the table.
